append.detail: 2026-11-09: added scripts/audit/route-family-audit.mjs, a runnable route-family audit. It visits 25 public route families at 390 and 1280 and records HTTP status, page and console errors, horizontal overflow, axe WCAG A/AA serious and critical violations and a full-page screenshot, writing report.json, report.md and shots/. Checked against a static page where it caught overflow and a missing image alt. It could not run against the app from the cloud sandbox: next dev needs NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and the sandbox has no credentials. Run it with BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 (a local pnpm dev) or a preview URL, then file each finding as its own row. Signed-in, admin, API, security-boundary, SEO and performance proof are not covered by this script. Row stays OPEN. 2026-11-10: first real run (production build of main 247fa6a2c, 25 routes x 2 viewports): 0px overflow everywhere; findings filed as SCAN-1202 (/themes contrast), SCAN-1203 (/create-a-space scrollable region), SCAN-1204 (Google Fonts CSS blocked by connect-src), SCAN-1205 (hydration #418 on /pricing and /the-community). Four 404s were a stale route list, not regressions: /free-spotlight is dark until LAUNCH_ENTRY_ENABLED, /calendar and /podcasts have no page, login is /sign-in; the list is corrected. Signed-in and admin families are not covered yet.
